_README: Species recorded at Manly but OUTSIDE the reserve boundary, keyed by iNaturalist taxon id. The whole page is built from place 71836, which is the Cabbage Tree Bay Aquatic Reserve and stops at Fairy Bower; an animal a hundred metres north of that line is in water swimmers cross and is invisible to every query the baker makes. Merged after the species cache is read, so adding one costs no re-fetch. Each entry carries where, when and how many, because the honest line is not '0 records in the bay'. Delete an entry once iNaturalist indexes the animal inside the reserve — the merge already stands aside if the real list has it.

604230.name: Bump-head Mola
604230.where: at Fairy Bower, in this bay
604230.note: Photographed at Fairy Bower on 6 September 2026 and confirmed by four identifiers. The pin falls 31 metres INSIDE the reserve polygon — this fish was in the bay — but iNaturalist had not yet indexed the observation into the place, so the bay's own species list does not carry it. That indexing catches up on its own, and when it does this hand-added record stands aside for the real one. A second upload of the same animal sits 54 m inside; a third report that morning had no photograph and is 60 m outside. Only four sunfish of any kind have ever been recorded within five kilometres of here.
